summary.intent: Address the minor gap noted in PR #246: the interrupted-run guard only checked a package's current working-tree `package.workspace` candidates, so a staged version bump in the old (HEAD) workspace went unnoticed.
summary.outcome: Fixed the guard so staged version sources from the package's prior workspace are also detected, added a partial-run test verified by mutation check to fail without the fix, updated the versioning spec and changeset, passed full CI (92.72%), and committed and pushed onto #247 with a description note.

repo: The six PRs (#241, #242, #244-#247) form one native stack (#243) to be merged in order; follow-up fixes to earlier PRs are committed onto the top of the stack (#247).

Interrupted-run guard in the version command builds the list of staged files that could affect a package's version from the working-tree `package.workspace` via `version_source_paths` and a candidates function.
Behavior changes are documented in docs/specs/versioning.json (the E121 interrupted-run criterion was extended) and need a changeset.
`just ci` runs the full pipeline including lint and coverage (currently 92.72%).
Work is done in a git worktree (.claude/worktrees/notes-unreadable).

code.finding: Interrupted-run guard computes staged version-source paths from the working-tree package.workspace only; fix adds a branch that also considers the HEAD workspace so a staged bump in the old workspace is detected.
Added a partial-run test for a package whose workspace changed in the working tree but not in HEAD; confirmed to fail when the new branch is disabled.
Modified alongside lib.rs to expose the staged-source/workspace candidate logic needed by the guard.

workflow: Mutation-check new tests by temporarily disabling the fix, confirming the test fails, then restoring the file.
Run long full-CI jobs in the background and read the result on task notification before committing.
Keep scratch files (commit messages, helper scripts) in the scratchpad directory rather than the repo.

friction: First attempt at applying the staged-source fix had malformed argument arrays and needed a rerun of the partial-run tests.
Fix required a recompile and a second round of edits before the test passed.
#247's own GitHub checks and the latest status of #241/#242 had not been re-verified.
open_items: Verify GitHub checks on #247 after the push, and re-check #241 and #242 status.
Merge the stack in order (#241, #242, #244, #245, #246, #247) once checks are green.
